children.proof_route: Prove the scalar two-point L^(4/3)→L² inequality. Normalize weighted L^(4/3) norm to one; away from constants use strict Jensen and compactness, near constants use the uniformly positive second-order gap (exponent 4/3). Compact p∈[a,b] gives one r>0. This is only an inequality in two real variables and has no code, event, dimension, transitivity, derivative, or asymptotic assumptions. More concretely, divide the Jensen gap ((E|f|^(4/3))^(3/2)−(Ef)^2) by Var(f) on the compact unit sphere away from constants.
